name: Quality and Process Control in Textiles
description: Process and quality control basics, quality management, cost of quality, statistical process control, six sigma and process capability; bale management, process and quality control at various stages of yarn manufacturing (blowroom, carding, drawing, roving and spinning); process and quality control in weaving preparatory processes (winding, warping and sizing); process and quality control in weaving, knitting and nonwoven; fabric defect analysis; applications of AI-ML in textile process and quality control.
